Guides/Knowledge & data

Test and tune retrieval

Inspect retrieved context before using it in answers.

Where to start

Inspect retrieved context before using it in answers.

Steps

  1. Select a knowledge base, open Retrieval and enter a realistic question. Inspect the returned chunks and scores.
  2. In base settings, choose full-text, semantic or hybrid retrieval as supported by the index. Adjust Top K and the score threshold using test results.
  3. For reranking, select a configured rerank model. Repeat with alternate wording and a question outside the documents.

Check the result

Economy indexing has no vectors and only supports full-text search. Reranking adds a model call and may send chunk content to the selected provider.
